name: vidmill
description: Open-source AI video editing toolkit: FFmpeg, Faster-Whisper, FaceFusion and DeepFilterNet exposed as connected CLI tools that any human or AI agent can orchestrate.
job_model: Tools read/write artifacts inside one job directory. Each tool consumes the job's current video artifact and records its output in job.json, so chains are resumable and inspectable with `vmill status`.

tools.name: probe
tools.purpose: Open a video as a job and record its media info (probe.json).

tools.name: transcribe
tools.purpose: Word-level transcript of the current video (transcript.json + srt).

tools.name: plan
tools.purpose: Build cut_plan.json: segments to keep/drop from silence detection + explicit/agent cuts.

inputs.--pad: keep this many seconds around speech

tools.name: cut
tools.purpose: Apply cut_plan.json to the current video -> cut.mp4 (trim+concat, audio kept in sync).

inputs.--plan-file: plan to apply (default: latest in job)

tools.name: delogo
tools.purpose: Remove a watermark/logo: conservative text-overlay auto-detection in the corners, or an explicit pixel region -> delogo.mp4.

tools.name: clean
tools.purpose: Denoise + loudness-normalize audio -> cleaned.mp4.

inputs.--engine: dfnet (DeepFilterNet env) or ffmpeg afftdn fallback

tools.name: captions
tools.purpose: Burn word-synced captions from transcript.json -> captioned.mp4.

tools.name: face
tools.cmd: vmill face --job <dir> --image face.jpg [--model inswapper_128] [--extra '...raw facefusion args...']
tools.purpose: Swap a reference face onto the current video (FaceFusion headless) -> swapped.mp4.

tools.name: music
tools.purpose: Curated no-copyright music & SFX: list, download into a job, mix under the video.
tools.engine: vidmill curated catalog (CC0 / Public Domain / CC BY, commercial-safe)

tools.name: auto
tools.purpose: Fully automatic edit with zero manual work: the local free pass removes pauses, still segments and retakes, removes watermarks, generates subtitles, cleans audio and exports. With --ai (and VIDMILL_AI_KEY set) makes ONE compact LLM call to suggest extra cuts; without a key it still delivers the free edit.
tools.engine: vidmill local engines + optional OpenAI-compatible checkpoint

tools.name: ai
tools.purpose: AI editor: the model calls any vidmill tool through OpenAI-compatible function calling to customize the edit from plain language. Needs VIDMILL_AI_KEY (or OPENAI_API_KEY); the video is never uploaded.
tools.engine: OpenAI-compatible API + the local tool registry

tools.name: skills
tools.purpose: List, read and edit reusable AI editing skills (SKILL.md recipes). Bundled skills ship with vidmill; user and project skills override them.

inputs.name: skill name
inputs.--description: when the AI should use it

tools.name: overlay
tools.cmd: vmill overlay --job <dir> (--image logo.png [--position top-right] [--scale 0.15] [--opacity 0.9] [--at 0] [--to 10] [--fade 0.3] | --video broll.mp4 [--mode pip|cutaway] [--at 5] [--to 11] | --spec overlays.json)
tools.purpose: Overlay images, logos/watermarks and B-roll onto the current video: picture-in-picture or full-frame cutaway with the main audio kept. Writes overlay_N.mp4 and rebinds the current video, so exports and further edits chain on top.

tools.name: vision
tools.purpose: Local visual understanding: scene cuts, a searchable frame index, zero-shot tags, smart thumbnails and transcript-to-B-roll matching. The free path uses colour, transcript and filename heuristics; an optional local image-text model adds semantic search.

inputs.--library: extra folder of images/videos for B-roll
inputs.--extract: B-roll: cut clips and write an overlay spec

tools.engine: vidmill vision (local frame analysis + optional image-text model)

tools.name: hyperframes
tools.purpose: Render a HyperFrames HTML composition and place it as an intro/outro, or render it on its own. Requires Node.js 22+; HyperFrames is fetched on demand through npx.

tools.name: mcp
tools.purpose: MCP server on stdio: every vidmill tool exposed to AI agents (Claude Desktop, agent frameworks) with auto-derived schemas.

tools.name: serve
tools.purpose: Local web UI on the job model: drag-drop upload, run the automatic edit, live log, play/download the result. Stdlib only; loopback by default.
tools.engine: vidmill (embedded single-page UI + stdlib http server)

tools.name: export
tools.purpose: Export the current video with a delivery preset -> final.mp4. GPU encode is auto-detected and verified; CPU fallback is automatic.

tools.name: pipeline
tools.purpose: Run a chain of tools in order, skipping steps whose artifacts already exist (resumable).

tools.name: status
tools.purpose: Show artifacts, media info and the tool history of a job.

tools.name: doctor
tools.purpose: Check which engines are installed and usable on this machine.
